## Which format should I choose?

- **PDF** – every slide on its own page. Best for printing, note-taking and reading on a phone or tablet.
- **HTML** – the interactive slide show in a single file. Open it in any browser (no internet needed) and
  move through the slides with the **arrow keys**; press **F** for full screen and **Esc** for an overview
  of all slides.
- **ZIP** – both formats for every lecture in one download. Right-click it and choose **Extract All**.
